verdict.rationale: The API overview docs say turbopuffer has a public OpenAPI specification and link the official turbopuffer/turbopuffer-openapi repo. That repo publishes a downloadable openapi.yml, from which the official TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C# and Rust clients are generated. The probe's 404s at website paths like /openapi.json do not contradict this, since the spec lives on GitHub. However, the README says the spec is primarily for internal use, may contain nonstandard features, and may break at any time. missing for 10: a stability/versioning guarantee for the spec, standards-compliant (non-internal) positioning, a hosted spec endpoint on the docs site, independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.
